I have three items sitting in my cart and I simply want to add a pack of iPhone screen protectors to my order. 

Instead, EVERY SINGLE screen protector listing forces this stupid "Buy It Now" / "Special Offer" promotion. It refuses to let me add the item to my basket and forces me into a completely separate checkout where I’m expected to pay separate postage costs!!!

I’m not playing these stupid games. I am not checking out twice and paying extra shipping fees just because your system blocks the cart button to pull a cheap trick. 
I just want to add some iPhone screen protectors to the rest of my order ans checkout. 

Because of this anti-consumer nonsense, you aren't just losing the screen protector sale you are losing the whole £20 order, I’m not buying a single thing from my basket until you fix this ridiculous system and let customers actually use normal shopping cart (and if you challenge this review, I will never purchase anything from you again)
data.review_headline: Forced "Buy It Now" dark patterns are losing you sales. Unusable system.

data.review_body:
Update: July 27, 2026
Twelve days after the July 14th deadline to they respond to my dispute, they are giving the buyer just 3 days (including a weekend day) to resubmit the exact same evidence provided when the dispute was first opened.
Not only do they waste the buyer's time, but they also set a tight deadline hoping the buyer won't see the request in time. Bear in mind: it took them 14 days to review the evidence I submitted, yet now they demand a response within 2 business days. This speaks volumes about the integrity of the AliExpress platform.
I have just resubmitted the video showing the opening of the package (which arrived empty), photos of the labels, and the condition of the package before it was opened.
I’ll likely provide another update in about 15 days, when they ask for the same evidence for the third time.
STAY AWAY FROM ALIEXPRESS.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
ALIEXPRESS is definitely one site to avoid.
I bought a lithium battery, and the package arrived empty.(even though the bubble wrap where the battery should have been was there).
I opened a dispute on July 7, 2026, including a video of me opening the empty package and the weight of the package, and photos of the empty sealed package.  ALIEXPRESS said they would resolve it before July 14, 2026, yet today—July 23, 2026—I am still waiting for a resolution to the dispute and a refund for the item that never arrived.
There is a difference of only 8g between the weight I measured on an old scale and the shipping weight. A 1200mAh battery should weigh much more than that.
ALIEXPRESS won't resolve the issue, even with photos, videos, and weight measurements.
data.review_headline: AliExpress fails to resolve empty package shipping scam

Seller told paypal it did ship and gave a fake tracking number that couldn't be located.  Seller told me to cancel the dispute and he would refund the money. No way!  Finally got my refund from paypal today 5 weeks later.

Dear AliExpress Escalation Team,

I am writing to submit official, non-refutable evidence regarding the non-delivery and customs rejection of my Choice DDP order.

1. Official Logistics Status (Speedaf / 17TRACK - Tracking #MA052781271R):
As per the official tracking system updated on July 16, 2026, the status explicitly reads:
[Morocco] Clearance Exception [Import clearance failure, Product is not for personal use]

2. Local Carrier Statement (MedAfrica Express):
The local delivery company confirmed in writing that individual customs clearance cannot be processed by the recipient, and that the package return must be initiated directly by AliExpress / Seller.

Summary & Claim:
The package was officially rejected by customs on July 16, 2026.
The item was NEVER delivered to me and remains strictly in carrier custody / returning to sender.
Under Moroccan regulations, individual customs clearance certificates are not issued to buyers for commercial rejection. The attached 17TRACK / Speedaf system status is the ONLY valid official proof available.
Since I paid under the Choice service and the package cannot be cleared or delivered, keeping my funds violates Buyer Protection policy.
I demand an immediate FULL REFUND of $87.08.
Attached:
Official 17TRACK / Speedaf Tracking System Screenshot showing Clearance Failure.
Official Written Communication from local carrier MedAfrica.
